task: historical supportive-order occurrence in first six hours after admission
population: ED-to-hospital admissions with at least one oral-GSN order in six hours

label_definition.saline_iv: exactly named 0.9% sodium chloride/isotonic saline, IV or IV DRIP; excludes flushes and carrier bags by name
label_definition.ondansetron: ondansetron or ondansetron ODT, any route
label_definition.bowel_regimen: senna or docusate sodium, any route

interpretation: historical order imitation only; no appropriateness or safety labels
